format_notes.color: #rrggbb (lowercase). Legacy hsl triplet 'H S% L%' converts with hslToHex/hexToHsl in direct-edit/site/style.ts; hsl(var(--x)) wrappers are emitted for legacy shadcn aliases only.
format_notes.font: a stack declared in the site's fonts list
format_notes.easing: cubic-bezier(a, b, c, d) or a keyword

roles.label: Page background
roles.description: The colour every page sits on.

roles.label: Cards and panels
roles.description: Cards, popups, sheets: a surface sitting on the page.

roles.label: Soft panels
roles.description: Sunken or tinted areas: fields, wells, rails, hover.

roles.label: Text
roles.description: Main text, read against the page and panels.

roles.label: Quiet text
roles.description: Secondary text, hints, captions.

roles.label: Faint text
roles.description: Placeholders and disabled text.

roles.label: Lines
roles.description: Hairline borders and dividers.

roles.label: Strong rules
roles.description: The heavier rule under heads and feet.

roles.label: Main accent
roles.description: The one brand colour: buttons, marks, focus, the current page.

roles.label: Text on the accent
roles.description: Text that sits on a filled accent.

roles.label: Accent as text
roles.description: The accent used as text on the page (must pass 4.5:1).

roles.label: Hover wash
roles.description: The accent as a quiet fill: chips, selected row, row under the pointer.

roles.label: Second accent
roles.description: An optional second brand colour (celadon, gold, rust).

roles.label: Warning red
roles.description: Errors and destructive actions.

roles.label: Done green
roles.description: Done, ready, saved, live.

roles.label: Attention amber
roles.description: Needs attention.

roles.label: Popup backdrop
roles.description: The dimming behind a popup (translucent).

roles.label: Section banners
roles.description: Behind section titles: a colour or a gradient.

roles.label: Body text font
roles.description: Running text and controls.

roles.label: Headings font
roles.description: Titles and mastheads (older name: heading).

roles.label: Menu font
roles.description: Navigation.

roles.label: Caption font
roles.description: Captions and small notes.

roles.label: Reading font
roles.description: Long-form reading.

roles.label: Label font
roles.description: Kickers, facts, datelines (the registry voice).

roles.label: Text size
roles.description: Overall text size multiplier (1 = as designed).

roles.label: Corners
roles.description: Corner radius of panels and cards. 0 for square.

roles.label: Field corners
roles.description: Corner radius of buttons and fields.

roles.label: Small-mark corners
roles.description: Chips, tags, dots.

roles.label: Panel shadow
roles.description: The shadow under a sheet or panel.

roles.label: Popup shadow
roles.description: The shadow under a menu or popup.

roles.label: Spacing step
roles.description: The base gap; the scale is gap-1..gap-5 (4, 8, 12, 18, 24).

roles.label: Page width
roles.description: Standard content width (compact 440, standard 640, wide 940, full 1180).

roles.label: Reading width
roles.description: Line length for long text.

roles.label: Header height
roles.description: Height of the site header, so a hero can sit under it.

roles.label: Easing
roles.description: The one easing curve.

roles.label: Speed
roles.description: Normal transition time (fast 120, base 180, slow 320 ms).
